attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No extraction/no-extraction theorem yet maps short EF+SAT_U proofs to functional label properties or to row-residual robustness against all subthreshold D_N.
steps: Substitute any SIZE(L^c) SAT circuit into every generated query; beta=0 removes the c-dependent exponent and gives the valid target bridge when max{rho,q}<1+epsilon.

assumptions: Circuit size is nonuniform fan-in-2 SIZE; all o(1) losses are uniform for fixed epsilon,c,q,rho,d.
Certificate search/verification for EF+SAT_U is advice-free and at most 2^{O(L_N)} on the generated range, so constructivity is not hidden in advice.
Dense functional certificates have label density at least 2^{-O(L_N)} and therefore fall under the earlier valid naturalization audit.
SAT-semantic certificates are sound only for the true SAT label vector; this is the named nonfunctional escape that must prove residual robustness.
definitions: source object: H_N^{SAT}(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) on N source bits, with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and query length L_N=(log N)^d.
target object: SAT notin P/poly, reached contrapositive to SAT_L in SIZE(L^c) for every fixed c under the same nonuniform Boolean circuit model.
controlled interface: beta-zero batched substitution through an advice-free generator G_N of size N^{rho+o(1)}; each target call has polylog length and no row-specific advice.
target-preserving condition: q,rho<1+epsilon, d>1, same SIZE model, fixed c absorbed as L_N^c=N^{o(1)}, and row patches charged O(N) gates each.
Psys: EF+SAT_U is extended Frege augmented with semantic SAT axioms only for U_N={G_N(x,j)}; functional soundness means validity for all label vectors on U_N.
Row residual: D_N agrees with H_N except on R_N source rows; robustness requires every subthreshold D_N to leave |R_N| above the equality-patching cutoff.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No named strong certificate system has yet been shown to satisfy DirectClusterSound at logarithmic projection width without also yielding a large constructive useful property. Resolution-style local traces fail the gap by the Tseitin falsifier.
steps: Fix an accepting cluster C from the beta-zero XOR certificate and record h=|Q(C)| and proof-view decision width w.
Define the shadow P_C by existentially quantifying only the proof-view labels seen by C while leaving all unqueried target labels free.
Completeness gives H_N^SAT in P_C, so one accepting assignment to the h queried target bits yields density at least 2^{-h}.
If w=O(log N), dynamic programming over the proof-view CSP decides P_C within poly(2^N) time, so the property is constructive in the natural-proofs sense.
If DirectClusterSound(C,s_N) holds, no size-s_N circuit truth table lies in P_C, giving usefulness against the exact target class.
If only ordinary soundness is available, odd-charge Tseitin supplies locally satisfiable clusters whose shadows ignore the target labels, so usefulness collapses.
Independently, if the certificate leaves a sparse residual row set R_N, nonuniform equality patches give C(H_N^SAT)<=C(D_N)+O(|R_N|N), contradicting any subthreshold source lower bound.

assumptions: Model: V_N is deterministic after fixing public coins, or the seed is fixed uniformly before the naturalness audit.
Regime: h=|Q(C)| and w=w(C) satisfy h+w<=A log N for an absolute A.
Uniformity: C and the local predicates of V_N are describable or enumerable in time poly(2^N), with no hidden polynomial advice selecting rows after seeing the target circuit.
Completeness: H_N^SAT has an accepting global certificate whose restriction to C gives at least one accepting local view.
Usefulness is against the exact target class SIZE_N(s_N), not against P or NP as a slogan.
Naturalness pressure is conditional on PRFs computable in the targeted circuit class and secure against poly(2^N)-time truth-table distinguishers.
definitions: source object: H_N^SAT is the beta-zero XOR function H_N^{SAT}(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
target object: SIZE_N(s_N) is the nonuniform Boolean circuit class on N input bits with s_N=N^{1+epsilon} or the named threshold being audited.
controlled interface: an enumerable local proof cluster C for a verifier V_N, with target projection Q(C), proof-view CSP W(C), and cluster shadow P_C over N-bit truth tables.
target-preserving condition: DirectClusterSound(C,s_N) says no D in SIZE_N(s_N) and no assignment to the proof-view variables satisfy all checks in C when target labels are D restricted to Q(C).
cluster shadow: P_C={F: there exists a proof-view assignment making all checks in C accept on F restricted to Q(C)}.
projection-decision width: w(C) is the treewidth or decision-DP width of the proof-view CSP after the target labels in Q(C) are supplied.

steps: Fix H_N^SAT with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
Assume an accepted DirectClusterSound-MCSP_beta0 certificate opens labels A_N(x,j) through an adaptive cover of exponent alpha_ad.
Flatten the adaptive transcript into a nonuniform circuit for each label bit; the largest cost is N^{alpha_ad+o(1)} by the alpha_ad maximum.
Compute D_N(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} A_N(x,j) using M_N copies of the opener, giving size N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ad}+o(1)}.
Use semantic soundness outside R_N to identify D_N with H_N^SAT off the residual set.
Hardwire residual corrections; the branch convention charges O(|R_N|N)=N^{r+1+o(1)} gates.
Compare with the claimed N^{1+epsilon} lower bound. If max{rho,q+alpha_ad,r+1}<1+epsilon, the certificate carrier proves its own subthreshold upper bound.

attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a conditional carrier falsifier and exponent audit. It does not prove P != NP, and it does not rule out high-adaptive-dimension, nonfunctional, non-natural certificates.

assumptions: Circuit model is unrestricted fan-in-two Boolean circuits; singleton correction for an exceptional x costs O(N) in the packet's size convention.
Psys soundness is semantic, not merely local: accepted labels equal SAT(G_N(x,j)) for every nonresidual x and all queried j.
The adaptive cover is a true functional opener for labels, not only a verifier transcript that cannot be used to compute A_N(x,j).
All exponents q,rho,r,epsilon,tau,a_l,mu_l,omega_l are fixed constants up to o(1) losses.
Non-claim boundary: the lemma is a route-specific falsifier for this carrier interface, not a proof of P != NP.
definitions: source object: DirectClusterSound-MCSP_beta0 certificate family Pi_N whose accepted certificate opens putative labels A_N(x,j) for SAT(G_N(x,j)) and optionally carries MCSP/MKtP lower-bound annotations for the induced label rows.
target object: the unrestricted Boolean circuit lower bound C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon} and any length-balanced E-language lower bound extracted from that explicit truth-table family.

controlled interface: an adaptive certificate opener with setup exponent tau, level-l summary count/width exponents a_l,mu_l, local opener exponents omega_l, and residual set R_N where semantic agreement is not forced.

target-preserving condition: the verifier, residual enumerator, generator G_N, and any hard-row selector are advice-free and E-uniform; for the no-go direction, even nonuniform hardwiring of a low-cover certificate is enough to refute an unrestricted lower-bound claim.
Beta-zero regime: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, and the query generator has circuit overhead N^{rho+o(1)} on the same N scale.
Residual exponent: |R_N|<=N^{r+o(1)} and D_N(x)=xor_j A_N(x,j) agrees with H_N^SAT outside R_N.

equations.valid_when: Applies after D_N agrees with H_N^SAT outside an enumerated residual set R_N of size N^{r+o(1)}.

equations.label: finite_falsifier_threshold
equations.valid_when: Requires the target lower-bound claim and the constructed upper bound to use the same unrestricted circuit model and N-scale.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: The no-go does not apply if alpha_ad>=1+epsilon-q, or r>=epsilon, or the certificate only proves a high-cover nonfunctional invariant with no label opener and no residual approximant.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Main contribution-making move for this cycle: a theorem-shaped finite falsifier for beta-zero MCSP/MKtP certificate carriers.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For the beta-zero XOR family H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), any DirectClusterSound-MCSP_beta0 certificate implementation with adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad and residual exponent r gives C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ad,r+1}+o(1)}. Hence a claimed lower bound C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon} is falsified whenever max{rho,q+alpha_ad,r+1}<1+epsilon.

assumptions: The row lower bound is nonuniform unrestricted circuit complexity, so a hardwired opening scheme is enough to refute it.
The cover computes every row bit, not merely checks a sampled consistency predicate.
The threshold theta is constant and measured in the row input length m.
definitions: source object: an accepted MCSP/MKtP certificate for a truth-table row T_m in {0,1}^{2^m} claiming C(T_m)>2^{theta m}.
target object: a valid no-side carrier row usable for E lower-bound extraction through the low-image or beta-zero XOR interface.
controlled interface: adaptive openings of T_m(i) through global summaries, per-level summaries, and local decoders with exponent alpha_ad.
target-preserving condition: a positive route must either avoid all subthreshold openings or prove a non-natural hard-row certificate that is searchable without advice.

equations.label: row_cover_upper_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when the adaptive cover opens every bit of the claimed hard MCSP/MKtP row with uniform exponent alpha_ad.

equations.label: row_survival_gate
equations.valid_when: Required when the certificate is meant to survive as a valid no-side source at threshold 2^{theta m}.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A carrier escapes only by proving high adaptive cover dimension for the row or by not exposing a functional row at all.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Source-side sanity check feeding the beta-zero XOR exponent ledger q+alpha_ad.
candidate_lemmas.statement: An MCSP/MKtP no-side row certificate at threshold 2^{theta m} is invalid if the accepted row has adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad<theta; the cover itself yields unrestricted circuits of size 2^{alpha_ad m+o(m)} for the row.

assumptions: Advice bits naming the hard row are not allowed in the target language definition.
If multiplexing is used, the distinct-image entropy D is included in the extraction denominator.
This lemma diagnoses transfer validity; it does not prove the hard row exists.
definitions: source object: a set of accepted MCSP/MKtP certificates containing at least one hard row per length.
target object: an E-uniform language or explicit truth-table family with an unrestricted circuit lower bound.
controlled interface: selector, rank/unrank map, or multiplexing table used to turn accepted certificates into a single target family.
target-preserving condition: the selected row is produced by a deterministic E-uniform procedure, or the multiplexing loss is explicitly charged in the exponent.

equations.label: multiplexing_charge
equations.valid_when: Applies when hard accepted rows are accessed by E-uniform distinct-image multiplexing with density loss kappa and image entropy D.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Fails to quarantine only if an explicit advice-free selector or a fully charged multiplexing construction is supplied.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Uniformity ledger preventing advice-selected MCSP hardness from being mistaken for a language lower bound.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Existential hard accepted rows do not give a target-preserving language lower bound unless the row selector or multiplexing map is advice-free and E-searchable; otherwise the consequence is only a nonuniform hard-string assertion.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: Below alpha_ad<1+epsilon-q and r<epsilon, the certificate collapses into a small circuit for H_N^SAT; above the threshold, this falsifier stops explaining failure and the route must prove genuine high-cover row hardness.
held_fixed_controls: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and L_N=(log N)^d remain beta-zero.

gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch needs a concrete exponent phase test for beta-zero XOR certificates, not another abstract hardness-magnification restatement.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A padded SAT-query family H_N^SAT with M_N=N^q polylog-length queries, together with a DirectClusterSound-MCSP certificate whose Merkle-like label oracle opens SAT labels and leaves a residual set R_N.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal flattening lemma from the adaptive opening transcript to unrestricted circuits, plus a semantic-soundness lemma that D_N agrees with H_N^SAT off the residual list.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: adaptive cover exponent alpha_ad, varied across the threshold 1+epsilon-q while q,rho,r are fixed.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 76 upgrades the prior alpha_ad audit by coupling it to the beta-zero query count and sparse residual correction.
